title: Brilliantly Fabric
description: This modpack is a fabric modpack that improves performance, and quality! It includes a shader and it is compatible with multiplayer on servers that are purely vanilla!
body: A performance improver for both high end, and low end PCs. It is also client sided and can be used on servers, comes with a shader that is for high end PC's. It also has many resource packs such as fresh animations to make your experience feel very fun!
